comparison_class.definition: Instrument A: prior instances of a higher-high/higher-low structure holding above the 20-period average with rising volume, this timeframe
comparison_class.why_this_class: nearest mechanically-defined analogue available from this instrument's own OHLCV history

decomposition.sub_claim: volume family confirms (above 20-day avg volume on up days)

thesis: Instrument A closed above both its 20- and 50-period moving averages with the 20 above the 50. The breakout family is unconfirmed (no new 20-day high yet) but the oscillator family is not overbought and the volume family is mildly supportive. ATR-based structure places invalidation below the recent swing low; the exit sits near the prior range high. This is a continuation setup, not a fresh breakout -- confidence is moderate, not high.
what_would_change_my_mind: A close back below the 20-period moving average, or the 50-period moving average rolling over, would invalidate the trend family's vote.
